candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order POST /v1/orders returns HTTP 500; the order service is the failing dependency producing the checkout errors.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side root cause (db pool, redis, payment latency) is not established; only the order 500 propagation is observed.

report.explanation: Traces and logs show checkout 502s consistently caused by order POST /v1/orders returning 500 within tens of ms. Gateway itself is healthy (/readyz 200). The bounded candidate is order-service HTTP 500 propagation; the specific order-internal fault is not yet evidenced.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for the failing POST /v1/orders requests to identify the internal 500 cause
Order dependency metrics (postgresql pool, payment, inventory/redis) to rule out db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency
